method.title: Method notes
method.night: A night is the longest sleep session, of more than 2 hours, that begins between noon of one date and noon of the next. It carries the date of the day it began.
method.oxygen: Oxygen figures count only nights with at least 3 hours of recording. "Minutes under 90 %" is the accumulated time the watch reports with SpO<sub>2</sub> below 90 %.
method.limits: A wrist oximeter measures by reflection and is sensitive to movement, arm position and strap fit. Its values are a guide and do not replace clinical oximetry or a sleep study.
method.scores: The report leaves out the maker's own scores, such as the sleep score, because their formula is not public.
